_doc: Full combo smoke run by Sonnet sub-agent 2026-05-11. Covered Sections A (partial), C (core surfaces), D (regression guards), E (Pro admin pages + feature toggles), F (a11y spot-checks), S (Pro supplements). Journeys and B/F/S sections partially skipped due to Bash/WP-CLI permission denied in sandbox. 10 from-origin failures found — see failures[]. Previous run (2026-05-09) was inline Opus focused walk that was GREEN; this run is a deeper surface pass that uncovered dormant bugs.
executor: sonnet-subagent (combo mode, Playwright MCP + source read; Bash/WP-CLI denied in sandbox)

failures.triage_note: GET /wp-json/listora/v1/listings returns raw WP REST array (WP_REST_Posts_Controller default) not the documented Listora envelope. /search correctly returns {listings,total,pages,has_more}. created_at and updated_at fields also absent.
failures.actual: Plain JSON array of WP post objects (id, date, date_gmt, guid, modified, slug, status, type, link, title...)
failures.file_hint: wp-content/plugins/wb-listora/includes/rest/class-listings-controller.php — missing prepare_items_response override; extends WP_REST_Posts_Controller but get_items does not wrap in Listora envelope

failures.triage_note: No Claim CTA button rendered on listing detail for unclaimed listings (is_claimed=false confirmed via REST). Claim text only appears as a JS i18n string. No data-wp-on--click='actions.openClaimModal' element found in DOM. Sidebar shows only Contact+Business Hours.
failures.expected: Claim this listing button visible on detail page for unclaimed listing; prompts login for anon, opens claim modal for logged-in member
failures.actual: No interactive claim element in DOM. claimSubmitted IAPI state key exists in JS store but no template trigger rendered.
failures.file_hint: wp-content/plugins/wb-listora/templates/blocks/listing-detail/render.php or tabs.php — Claim CTA block not rendered; conditional suppression may be firing incorrectly for non-owner logged-out view

failures.triage_note: Every listing detail REST call fires a DB error: Unknown column 'name' in 'field list'. Query uses 'name' but table DDL defines 'title'. Services silently return empty on every detail endpoint call. Confirmed in debug.log for listing IDs 1203 and 1283.
failures.expected: SELECT id, title, description, price, duration FROM wp_listora_services
failures.actual: SELECT id, name, description, price, duration FROM wp_listora_services — DB error on every call, empty services array returned
failures.file_hint: wp-content/plugins/wb-listora/includes/rest/class-listings-controller.php:711 — query uses 'name' but class-activator.php:362 defines column as 'title varchar(500)'

failures.triage_note: Listings CPT bulk actions missing Approve, Reject, Feature. Only Edit, Move to Trash, Send renewal reminder present.
failures.expected: Bulk actions include: Approve, Reject, Feature, Move to Trash
failures.actual: Bulk actions: Edit, Move to Trash, Send renewal reminder only

failures.triage_note: CPT list missing Status and Featured columns. Shows Renewals and Duplicate confirmed instead.
failures.expected: Columns include Status (publish/pending/draft indicator) and Featured (star/toggle)
failures.actual: Columns: Title, Type, Location, Rating, Renewals, Duplicate confirmed, Author, Listing Types, Categories, Comments, Moderator, Date — no Status, no Featured

failures.triage_note: Pre-existing PHP Parse error in tab-listings.php:456 (logged at 09:04 UTC before smoke run). Syntax error: unexpected end of file, expecting elseif/else/endif. Fires on every dashboard My Listings tab render.
failures.expected: Zero PHP parse errors in debug.log
failures.actual: PHP Parse error: syntax error, unexpected end of file, expecting 'elseif' or 'else' or 'endif' at line 456

failures.triage_note: admin.php?page=wb-listora-pro returns 403 for administrator. Page slug not in admin menu — not registered.
failures.expected: Pro dashboard page renders for administrator at admin.php?page=wb-listora-pro
failures.actual: 403: Sorry, you are not allowed to access this page
failures.file_hint: wp-content/plugins/wb-listora-pro/includes/class-pro-plugin.php — admin_menu registration missing or using wrong slug/capability

failures.triage_note: Outgoing Webhooks admin page returns 403 for administrator. Not present in admin menu.
failures.expected: Outgoing Webhooks page renders at admin.php?page=listora-webhooks
failures.actual: 403: Sorry, you are not allowed to access this page
failures.file_hint: wp-content/plugins/wb-listora-pro/includes/class-pro-plugin.php — listora-webhooks page registration missing from admin_menu callback

failures.triage_note: admin.php?page=wb-listora-features returns 403. Standalone features page not registered. Pro feature toggles ARE accessible via Settings > Pro Features tab (listora-settings&tab=pro-features) but the dedicated page slug 403s.
failures.expected: admin.php?page=wb-listora-features lists all 29 Pro feature toggles per runbook E.pro-admin-pages
failures.actual: 403 error — page slug not in admin menu

failures.triage_note: Submission wizard step indicator missing aria-current='step' on active step. Screen readers cannot identify the current wizard step. WCAG accessibility requirement per runbook F.a11y.
failures.expected: Active step element has aria-current='step' attribute
failures.actual: No elements with aria-current='step' found on /add-listing/ step 1; uses CSS class .is-current without ARIA attribute
failures.file_hint: wp-content/plugins/wb-listora/templates/blocks/listing-submission/render.php — step indicator markup uses .listora-submission__step-indicator.is-current class but no aria-current attribute

release_readiness.rationale: 2 critical failures (services column mismatch DB error on every listing detail call; PHP parse error in tab-listings.php) + 8 high/medium from-origin failures. The services column bug (C.db.services-column-mismatch) silently drops all services from every listing detail REST response and logs DB errors continuously. The parse error (D.parse-error-tab-listings) breaks dashboard My Listings tab for all users. Both are regressions from a pre-release codebase and must be fixed before tagging.
blockers: C.db.services-column-mismatch — critical: DB error on every listing detail call, services empty
D.parse-error-tab-listings — critical: PHP parse error breaks dashboard My Listings tab
release_readiness.recommended_next_step: 1. Fix class-listings-controller.php:711 (name -> title). 2. Fix tab-listings.php:456 (unclosed if block). 3. Fix Claim CTA template (C.member.claim). 4. Fix REST envelope (C.rest.contract). 5. Re-run smoke after fixes. 6. File Basecamp cards for remaining non-critical failures.
